# Tis The Season Holiday Lighting

Tis The Season Holiday Lighting provides professional holiday lighting installation for homes and businesses in Lee's Summit, Missouri, Raymore, Missouri, and nearby communities.

## Services

- Residential holiday lighting
- Commercial holiday lighting
- Custom lighting design
- Professional installation
- In-season maintenance and repair
- Post-season takedown
- Off-season storage

## Service area

- Lee's Summit, MO, including Winterset Valley, Summit Mill, Eagle Creek, Legacy Wood, Northpark Village, Stoney Creek, Napa Valley, Kensington Farms, Kessler Ridge, New Longview, Raintree Lake Estates, Summit Ridge, The Villas at Parkwood, Hawthorne Ridge, Hook Farms, Hawthorne Hill, Siena at Longview, and Woodside Ridge
- Raymore, MO, including Creekmoor

## What customers can expect

- Free estimates
- Guaranteed first-year pricing
- Commercial-grade LED lighting
- Fully insured installation crews
- The company provides the lights and materials
- Maintenance, takedown, and storage included
